summary: STORE-012F RETEST — Material Board Sync™ table-name fix verified. Backend pytest 16/17 PASS + 1 SKIP (env-only, no fresh WMB without approved materials). The previously failing TestSyncMaterialBoard::test_sync_idempotent now PASSES. Direct API verification: GET /api/material-boards/0c0d6a44-7070-4b19-9a00-b565cdeb45e2 returns 1 element with entity_id=i18n-recovery-1 matching the approved material in WMB 47821aa0...; sync called twice consecutively → added=0, skipped=1 both times (idempotency holds); decision_stage='specified' correctly set on source element AFTER the insert succeeds (raise-on-failure now in place at lines 836-838 and 875-877). Frontend live smoke: logged in as admin, opened /studio/moodboards/working/47821aa0..., clicked wmb-sync-go → wmb-sync-toast displayed '+0 added · 1 already on board', wmb-badge-specified-* count=1, wmb-badge-mat-* count=0 — badge promotion verified. The critical bug from iteration 221 (table 'material_board_items' → 'material_board_elements') is fully resolved.

minor.issue: The existing_eids dedup query on line 846 still wraps the read in bare except: pass. If that read silently fails, the next sync would re-insert duplicates instead of being idempotent. Recommend logging the exception (low risk — table now exists).

decision_stage='specified' promotion loop (lines 881-892) iterates over ALL approved elements, including those that were skipped because their entity_id was already on the Material Board. This is semantically fine (they ARE specified) but means the loop is not gated on whether THIS sync call actually added the row. Cosmetic only.
